enchantments.tooltip: Dampened: This item has been in a wet environment for too long and its original power has been weakened. Combine it with a Token of Vulkoor at the Altar of Vulkoor in the Red Fens to restore it back to its former glory.
+2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
True Chaos: This weapon is infused with the power of True Chaos. It does an additional 1 to 6 damage to non-chaotic targets and can only be wielded by Chaotic-aligned characters.
Cold Touch: The temperature around this weapon is colder than normal. A cold touch weapon deals an additional +1 cold damage on a successful hit.
Regeneration: Causes the wearer to regenerate 1 hit point a minute using positive energy.
